From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, May 1, 2026 at 3:10 PM PDT
Subject: Acme Corp POC — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks again for a great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) Success criteria (your input requested) — from our discussion today, initial items are:
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for typical query set (~1.5k tokens)
   - Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent requests for 2hr peak test
   - Accuracy: top-1 intent classification match to current prod >= 92% on your labeled 500-sample set
   - Cost target: per-1k-token cost below $0.18 (you mentioned budget constraints)

2) Evaluation plan (proposed):
   - Week 0: infra access + sample data ingest (ACME provides sanitized sample)
   - Week 1: baseline runs + short tuning pass (we run quantized variant and report metrics)
   - Week 2: extended load test + user-sim test; collect latency/cost numbers; joint review
   - Week 3: decision meeting (go/no-go) and next steps (pilot or scale)

3) Ownership and tasks
   - Acme: provide sanitized sample dataset (500 labeled rows) and allow API egress to test endpoints (Lena/Kevin)
   - Redwood: provide POC endpoints, run baseline and load tests (Marissa + Marcus)
   - Point people: Marissa Cole (PM & commercial), Marcus Lin (tech lead)

4) Access items we need from Acme:
   - Temp test account/IP allowlist details (see attached network_requirements.docx)
   - S3/GDrive link with sanitized sample set (or paste in response)

Attachments: network_requirements.docx (stub)

Please confirm these success criteria and the proposed timeline, or add/edit items in the attached evaluation template and return to me by Tue so we can kick off next week.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all — quick tech note and checklist before kickoff: 

1) Allowlist: Kevin, we need the CIDR or static IPs for your test subnet. If you can't provide static IPs we can also set up a short-lived SSH tunnel from your test host.
2) Sample format: we prefer a CSV with columns: id, input_text, label, metadata (json string). If you have nested JSON, please flatten or provide a mapping file.
3) Secrets: we will provide short-lived API keys for the POC endpoints; please confirm who should receive them (Kevin or a dedicated test account).
4) Load testing: we'll start at 10rps and ramp to 50rps over 30 minutes — let us know if you want a different profile.

I'll attach a short checklist to the mutual_action_plan.pdf after this note. Looking forward to the kickoff — Marcus
